notes.title: DevLog Update #12
notes.content:
Hello everyone!


After the previous playtest I wasn't happy with the way flying works. I've implemented the point and click mechanism because it was easier but at the end it was not engaging and challenging at all. I've always wanted to make the game as engaging and accessible as possible so I've decided to change it so that you can manually fly your ship instead of just clicking in a RTS style. This means more fun flying around, more challenges and dangers but most importantly this opens a possibility to implement controller support. Check out the latest update video linked below.




[previewyoutube="ZmZzojr9aww;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Your voice have been heard - check the latest DevLog update!
Void Harvest - open beta is now available!
notes.content:
Greetings explorers!

This beta offers a small slice of the full experience, but there's already plenty to dive into:


Explore one playable map filled with dangers and discoveries.
Mine asteroids, some are unstable and will explode if you're not careful.
Search and scan abandoned debris to uncover hidden blueprints.
Level up your character, earn skill points, and experiment with a limited talent tree.
Refine ore and craft a functional shield module.
Equip the shield to protect yourself while mining and surviving the void.


Your feedback will help shape what’s next. Jump in now and let me know what you think!

This test will run for two weeks, starting April 11th at 6PM CET and ending April 28th at 9AM CET.

You can leave feedback directly in-game via a Google Form – it really means the world to me and helps shape the future of the project. I’ve also set up a Discord channel, where you can report bugs, share thoughts, or just hang out and chat about the game.
